connector.name: Social Search MCP
connector.registryDescription: Deep social media search for LLMs: Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram & more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package social-search-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shubhamekapure account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SERPER_API_KEY
env.description: API key from serper.dev. Required if SEARCH_PROVIDER=serper.

env.name: SEARXNG_URL
env.description: URL of your SearXNG instance. Default: http://localhost:8080
